smokeTestNotes: Product and pricing pages reviewed in October 2026.
name: Interior AI
shortDescription: Turns a room photo or an interior sketch into a photoreal redesign. Pro is $49 a month.
longDescription: Interior AI restyles a room photo and includes Sketch2Image, which turns an interior sketch or a SketchUp screenshot into a photoreal render. Pro is $49 a month for 1,000 designs. Premium is $99 a month and adds virtual staging. Ultra is $199 a month.
pricingNotes: Pro is $49 per month for 1,000 designs. Premium is $99 per month. Ultra is $199 per month.
bestFor: A room photo that should become an interior mockup
An interior sketch that should become a photoreal render
notIdealFor: A whole-house blueprint with no interior photo or sketch
The only tool you use to virtually stage a listing
strength: Interior AI turns a room photo or an interior sketch into a photoreal redesign, including a SketchUp screenshot.
weakness: Pro is $49 per month, and virtual staging is listed on the $99 Premium plan rather than on Pro.

useCaseFit.floor-plan-rendering: Turns a room photo or an interior sketch into a photoreal redesign.
